name: libwebsockets-74631a53-blind23
instr:
# Warmcat's embedded C web stack without a test suite

The repository has received 23 separate undocumented edits.

A program built on this stack fetches documents, decodes the pictures in them and draws the result on a display, and it now gets a long list of things wrong. Nothing about the formats changed and nothing about the callers changed. The same documents and the same requests that used to be handled correctly are handled wrongly now, and in several places work that used to finish gives up partway or reports a failure after succeeding.

What ends up on the display is wrong in a number of ways. When a traced outline is given a thickness, one end of each thickened segment is built from the wrong coordinate, so the band drawn around the curve sits skewed away from the curve itself. Reading the drawing instructions out of that same markup consumes the wrong count of numbers for one instruction, so the figure that appears is not the one described. Asking for the angle of a point given as a pair of horizontal and vertical offsets in fixed-point arithmetic gives a wrong answer whenever the vertical offset is negative, and angles worked out that way come back mirrored or far outside the range they belong in. A compressed picture whose pixels are coded as references back to earlier output decodes to garbage, because the reach of a back-reference is accumulated short.
